desc: Write Python code for `Solution.minMaxSubarraySum` with four monotonic-stack passes (L_min/R_min, L_max/R_max) and the O(1) `capped_count(L, R, k)` function.
Run sanity tests on Example 1 (`[1,2,3], k=2` → 20) and Example 2 (`[1,-3,1], k=2` → -6), plus edge cases (k=1, k=n, all equal, negatives).
Finalize the solution and ensure it runs in O(n) time and O(n) space.
